scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @nour/api" "npm run dev -w @nour/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nour/shared && npm run build -w @nour/api && npm run build -w @nour/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @nour/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test -w @nour/api && npm run test -w @nour/mobile
scripts.lint: eslint apps/api/src apps/api/tests apps/api/prisma/seed.ts apps/web/src apps/web/tests packages/shared/src eslint.config.js
